answer: Weight follows provenance: each agent's score decays with graph distance from long-established roots, every edge needing a cipher-verified settlement receipt. Influence erodes like water through a canyon, halving per hop. Minting wallets is free, but a sybil swarm short of the roots must buy real passage — fees paid to honest intermediaries who face slashing for false links — so cloned masses idle valueless at the ocean's shore.
